GEORGE TASK FORMAT: 1

STACK: existing-express-feature-v1
TASK: P1 — Add note tags
KIND: implementation

GOAL

Extend the existing Express notes service with validated tags while preserving every existing route.

INSPECT

- current application routes
- existing tests and README
- Git status and diff

REQUIREMENTS

- R1: Preserve the existing GET /health, GET /notes, and POST /notes behavior.
- R2: POST /notes accepts optional tags: an array of one to five strings; trim and lowercase them, remove duplicates, and reject blank or over-24-character values with 400 JSON errors.
- R3: Every returned note includes tags, defaulting to an empty array.
- R4: GET /notes?tag=value returns only notes carrying the normalized tag; an empty tag query returns 400.
- R5: Add focused tag coverage without deleting baseline regression tests.
- R6: Update README and provide a completion report with focused and broad validation results.

WORKFLOW

W1 — Inspect frozen baseline
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6
Depends on: none

Inspect source, tests, documentation, and Git state before mutations.

W2 — Implement validated tag behavior
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4
Depends on: W1

Edit the route implementation and any required shared helpers only.

W3 — Add feature tests and docs
Covers: R5, R6
Depends on: W2

Preserve baseline tests and explain the feature in README.

VALIDATION

V1 — Focused tag tests
Covers: R2, R3, R4, R5
Run: node --test test/tags.test.js

V2 — Broad regression
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6
Run: npm test

STOP CONDITIONS

- S1: If dependency installation lacks explicit network approval or registry access, record Evidence Gap and leave the frozen fixture unchanged.
- S2: Do not claim completion while V1 or V2 is failing or unexecuted.

PERMISSIONS

- Workspace: autonomous
- Network: ask

EVIDENCE

Record the fixture commit, hidden acceptance result, validation attempts, tool calls, corrections, and completion ledger.
